edge_cases: H_Q=2 query heads share H_KV=1 key head (GROUP_SIZE=2); K stored [H_KV,S,D] row-major -- row j IS key vector j, Q.K^T needs no transpose, only swapped tile indices

GQA mechanism: the shared KV head's 4 weight croutons (per (tj,kt) tile pair) are packed into VTCM ONCE and left resident, reused by both query heads without re-packing -- only the activation (Q) side is re-packed per head/tile
2x2 grid of 32x32 output tiles per head; each accumulates over 2 D-tiles
HMX accumulator persists across D-tile matmuls (one mxclracc per out tile)
activation int8 in high byte of crouton slot (low bytes dead)
weight 4-deep packed; different load limit than activation
input range chosen so |requant| < 2048 (12-bit field exact, no saturation)
crouton pack/unpack staged via cacheable buffers + bulk vector copy

LCG fill draws from bits >>13 (not the raw low 3 bits) so head0 and head1's Q data don't alias -- the raw low bits of this LCG have a short period that evenly divides S*D=4096 and would silently repeat across the head boundary
wrong-grouping near-miss (forgets to advance the query pointer per head -- head1 reads head0's Q) must fail, specifically on head1's output range

signal: compute-bound (matrix engine, weight-crouton reuse across grouped query heads)
